comparison_with_20deg.interpretation: Lowering the split moves both route-only proxy peaks toward the observed 40-55 nm region and materially improves the route-only fit, but the common-error route-only model remains strongly disfavoured. Positive two-route mixtures remain competitive with or better than Model B.

geometry_caveats.horizontal_floor: sec(theta) is the ideal planar path-length factor for a horizontal surface normal to the beam. It is not a material-specific SE yield and omits saturation and collection.
geometry_caveats.mixture_amplitudes: All mixture amplitudes absorb unknown surface yield, intercepted fraction, detector visibility, and collection efficiency. Fitted components are not calibrated physical fractions.
geometry_caveats.vertical_tape: 1/sin(theta) assumes the ion's transverse direction is normal to a vertical tape plane. Actual interception and incidence also depend on azimuth, tape position/extent, shadowing, and detector visibility; none is available in the SRIM archive. This curve is therefore only a shape sensitivity, not a tape signal prediction.

integrity.production_pooling: two independent 100k seeds pooled at 41 thicknesses; 10k reconnaissance used only outside the production grid
